dct_description_sm: The general objectives are to: determine the species composition and relative abundance of marine fish within the study area; determine the distribution of marine fish and identify the habitat requirements of species present in the study; examine the food habits of several of the most abundant fish species; conduct basic life history analyses of the major fish species; examine the zooplankton community near the mouth of Frobisher Bay. Specific objectives for zooplankton are: to examine species composition, relative abundance, depth distribution of surface water large macroplankton (>1mm) known to be important in the diets of marine mammals, sea birds, and pelagic fish; to study the species composition and relative abundance of the smaller zooplanktoners utilized by larval fish, the latter themselves part of the plankton community.
dct_title_s: Near shore marine fisheries investigations in coastal areas of southeast Baffin Island
